assessments.reason: Checkout failure policy and payment presentation change. The orders visual group verifies the representative persisted Order consumer of checkout finalization; direct failure-page and transaction-label consumers are covered by targeted browser evidence outside that matrix.
assessments.consumers: getPaymentStatusById feeds components/client-table/transaction/options.ts, then Transaction columns and Status filters at /dashboard/client through the Transaction History tab. Explicit numeric labels 0-6 stay compatible and unknown values are rejected; contract fixtures prove all known labels stay identical. An extra desktop/mobile transaction-label browser check could not render the table and is explicitly recorded as a verification limitation, not passing evidence. Payments/checkout parsing feeds finalization, compensation, cancellation, resume/restart and local Order payment-state reads. These operations persist Order truth displayed by customer order history, so its existing orders visual group checks the representative dashboard consumer. Known wire/persistence values and normal transitions stay unchanged; affected PostgreSQL replay/recovery tests prove invalid states refuse side effects. Shared public errors flow from orders new/restart/resume through useOrder and cartStore.previousCheckoutError into /checkout/fail; desktop/mobile cart/quote/unknown cases and persisted unknown failure with an order ID verify its copy, actions and safe navigation. cartStore cart/product/optimistic/total behavior is unchanged; no shared layout/styles, catalog, product pricing or cart line rendering changes. Home/search/product/cart screenshots do not exercise these error/state-only changes.

assessments.reason: Verification and issue-tracking tooling only; no storefront runtime changes.
assessments.consumers: scripts/verification-evidence.mjs is imported only by scripts/verify.mjs and its tests. verify.mjs is invoked by package scripts, CI and pre-push; select-visual-checks.mjs orchestrates developer verification. No Nuxt route/component/store/domain reads these modules, and they perform no application or provider state writes. Workflow/docs/tests do not change rendered application state. Browser screenshots are not evidence for this tooling change; receipt/classifier/real-hook tests verify its consumers.
